Dear Assia,

Thank you for your clarification, we completely understand.

We have double-checked with you as there was a slight miscommunication regarding the shift charges, and everything is now clear. Kindly note that your unit number will be 401 instead of 406.

Also, we would kindly request you to share the IDs of all other guests so we can update the system accordingly.

Lastly, as a gentle reminder, we would like to follow up on the security deposit of AED 2,000 as well.

Thank you for your cooperation, and please let us know if you need any further assistance.
